headline: 《仙逆》电影领跑，新剧《魔女嘉莉》首播
summary: 本周影市由《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《误杀瞒天记3》领跑，待映含《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》；剧集端《魔女嘉莉》《The Reluctant Vampire》首播，《侠探杰克》《末日地堡》持续热播。

industryHighlights.text: 《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《误杀瞒天记3》领跑本周电影热作。
industryHighlights.en: Xian Ni Movie: Slaying Immortals and Drishyam 3 lead this week's film hits.

industryHighlights.text: 《魔女嘉莉》《The Reluctant Vampire》等新剧本周首播，奇幻惊悚题材集中。
industryHighlights.en: Carrie, The Reluctant Vampire and more premiere this week, with fantasy and thriller titles clustering.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧《侠探杰克》《末日地堡》《母狮》维持高热度。
industryHighlights.en: Reacher, Silo and Lioness remain among the hottest ongoing series.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单包括《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《泥面人》等。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films include Avengers 5, Dune 3 and Clayface.

headlineEn: Xian Ni Film Leads as Carrie Series Premieres
summaryEn: This week's film slate is led by Xian Ni Movie: Slaying Immortals and Drishyam 3, with Avengers 5 and Dune 3 upcoming; on TV, Carrie and The Reluctant Vampire premiere while Reacher and Silo stay hot.
